# Augustine Cobbold

> Software Engineer | Mobile & Full-Stack Development | AI & Automation Builder

## Professional Summary
Software Engineer with 3.5+ years of experience building and maintaining production software, specializing in native Android development with Kotlin, Java, and Jetpack Compose, full-stack Next.js/TypeScript applications, and workflow automation. Currently IT Specialist / CTO at Basilissa leading internal business systems and architecture. Previously developed FieldTool for Purple Wave, Inc. via DevOps Africa.

## Current & Recent Experience
- **IT Specialist / CTO | Basilissa (2026 – Present | Ghana):** Leading internal business systems, customer feedback, and HR assessment workflows across frontend, backend, databases, and deployment.
- **Software Developer (Android) | Purple Wave, Inc. via DevOps Africa (Jan 2023 – Jul 2026):** Developed and maintained production Android features for FieldTool, an offline-first inspection and auction data-capture platform handling thousands of uploads and 200+ media files per asset daily.
- **Website & Systems Administrator | Awiebo College of Education (2022):** Managed institution website, admissions systems, and digital infrastructure.

## Education & Qualifications
- **Diploma in Information Technology:** Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology (KNUST) (2026 – 2028)
- **Professional Software Development:** Codetrain (2021 – 2022)

## Key Projects & Published Applications
- **Phone 18 Calculator:** Monetized Android utility with 17,000+ downloads on Google Play Store featuring ML Kit OCR receipt scanning, Math Notes, tip/tax splitters, and AdMob monetization.
- **Shortcodes Ghana (formerly Dial Hash):** Unified gateway for telecom USSD shortcuts (MTN MoMo, Telecel Cash, AT) and trending live events & festival ticketing hub (https://shortcodes.cobbold.dev & Play Store).
- **DataWise:** Android data management utility with usage forecasting and a local on-device VpnService firewall to block background cellular data hogs (Google Play Store).
- **Spool:** High-performance web media streaming and synchronous ffmpeg MP3 audio extraction utility operating with zero server disk storage (https://spool.cobbold.dev).
- **FieldTool:** Production offline-first auction data-capture and inspection Android platform (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, CameraX, WorkManager, Room, Coroutines).
- **DevMock:** Published Android developer network simulation and API testing utility (Google Play Store & https://devmocks.vercel.app).
- **EcoCoders:** Environmental education SaaS platform with AI narration and Paystack subscriptions (https://ecocoders.cobbold.dev).
- **Bernie AI:** Android AI assistant platform integrating conversational LLMs, task automation, and WorkManager notifications.
- **Debbie:** Multi-channel personal automation assistant built with n8n, Telegram, and WhatsApp APIs.
- **Homelab Cloud Infrastructure:** High-availability self-hosted private cloud built on Proxmox VE, Coolify PaaS, Docker, Cloudflare Tunnels, and Tailscale.

## Core Technical Competencies
- **Mobile Development:** Android SDK, Kotlin, Java, Jetpack Compose, XML layouts, MVVM, Coroutines, Flow, Hilt, Room, CameraX, WorkManager, Offline Sync, React Native, Play Store releases.
- **Web & Backend:** Next.js (App Router), React, TypeScript, Node.js, REST APIs, JSON, PostgreSQL, Redis, SQLite, Firebase, AWS Cognito, JWT auth, PHP, SQL.
- **Cloud & DevOps:** Docker, Proxmox, Coolify, Cloudflare, Google Cloud Run, Vercel, Tailscale, CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Datadog, Sentry.
- **AI & Automation:** n8n Workflow Automation, LLM Integrations, Prompt Engineering.
